meta.name: cal-com-automation
meta.description: Automate Cal.com tasks via Rube MCP (Composio): manage bookings, check availability, configure webhooks, and handle teams. Always search tools first for current schemas.

copy.tagline: 自动管理 Cal.com 日程、预订与团队协作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Cal.com 管理会议和团队日程
copy.tagline_en: Automate Cal.com bookings, availability, and team management
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently manage meetings and team schedules with Cal.com

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以管理 Cal.com 的预约、检查空闲时段、配置网络钩子以及管理团队。它会先搜索当前可用的工具，然后按需执行操作。
howto.when: 当你提到预约、空闲时间、网络钩子或团队相关任务时触发。例如，要求“列出我的预约”或“检查下周一是否有空”。

say.text: 列出我未来一周的预约。
say.note: Claude 会调用工具获取预约列表。

say.text: 检查下周二下午3点是否有空。
创建一个新团队，名为“设计组”。
say.note: Claude 会调用团队创建工具。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage Cal.com bookings, check availability, configure webhooks, and handle teams. It will first search for available tools, then execute operations as needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention bookings, availability, webhooks, or team-related tasks. For example, 'list my bookings' or 'check availability next Monday'.

say_en.text: List my upcoming bookings for this week.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch the booking list.

say_en.text: Check if I'm free next Tuesday at 3 PM.
Create a new team named 'Design Team'.
say_en.note: Claude will call the team creation tool.
